summary: Cresud S.A.C.I.F. y A. filed Form 6-K to announce the upcoming interest payment on its Series XLIX fixed-rate notes. The filing confirms that on September 2, 2026, the company will pay the second semi-annual interest installment of USD 1,144,200.86 on USD 31,306,845 outstanding principal, at a 7.25% annual rate, covering March 2, 2026 through September 2, 2026. Caja de Valores S.A. serves as payment agent. This is a routine debt service disclosure, not a special situation. No structural changes, strategic events, or risk-arbitrage elements are present. The filing is purely administrative interest payment notification.
